feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 10:35am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Mainly W or SW 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in places, increasing 4 or 5 this evening, before backing S or SW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south later.


##Weather)##

Mist and fog patches with occasional outbreaks or rain this morning, clearing to mainly fair but with a few showers early afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Poor in mist and very poor in fog patches, otherwise moderate to good, becoming mostly good, occasionally moderate in showers this afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

S or SW 4 occasionally 5, soon backing S or SE 4 to 6, veering SW in the afternoon. Increasing mainly 6 occasionally 7 overnight for a time.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, building rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Rain soon arriving clearing to scattered showers in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Thursday, 4 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

SW or W 4 to 6.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming moderate, occasionally rough.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 5 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

W or SW 5 or 6, soon decreasing S or SW 4 or 5, then 3 or 4 in the afternoon. Backing S or SE later.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Showers, mainly isolated.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Saturday, 6 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

S or SE 3 or 4, soon backing E, falling variable or N, then settling W or SW later.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, with the risk of rain at times.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
